description: Nucleoid keeps travelled distances live with floating point absolute values
code:
offsets = [-2, 5, -7]
distances = offsets.map(offset -> Math.fabs(offset))
assert(distances, [2, 5, 7])
assert(distances, offsets.map(offset -> Math.abs(offset)))
offsets.push(-4)
assert(distances, [2, 5, 7, 4])
distances.sum()

description: Nucleoid derives independent reading magnitudes with fabs class rules
code:
class Reading(sample):
    this.sample = sample
$Reading.magnitude = Math.fabs($Reading.sample)
first = Reading(-3)
second = Reading(2)
assert([first.magnitude, second.magnitude], [3, 2])
first.sample = -4
assert([first.magnitude, second.magnitude], [4, 2])
[first.magnitude, second.magnitude]
